posts.title: Protecting the QMX's finals from "clock stall" while improving RF drive and efficiency
posts.description: One of the easiest ways to drive an RF output transistor in a simple, low-power transmitter is by driving the final transistor - typically a MOSFET - directly with a logic gate. There are a number of logic devices out there that are capable of doing so, having the necessary speed, slew rate and current sinking/sourcing ability to effectively overcome the gate capacitance of the typical FET devices
